how: PR-8: record agy002-g5-06. For even Delta the Wilson line is a function of the point, and the Gramian over the 24 points is covariant and not a multiple of the identity (eigenvalues 2.859, 3.069, 3.171). Main adds that for odd Delta it becomes covariant once the four lifts of each point are included. A structural fact of this frame; it is the Gramian of 24 evaluation vectors and carries no hierarchy
